timeline.label: Q1 FY2026 10-Q filed: revenue $1.81B quarter, heavy datacom capex ($547M quarter), share count 195.6M.
FY2025 10-K filed: revenue $5.81B (+23% YoY), operating cash flow $634M, capital spending $441M.
Segment reporting realigned to Datacenter and Communications vs Industrial effective FY2026.
Announced sale of Aerospace & Defense business for $400M; refocus on datacom/industrial photonics core.
II-VI completed Coherent acquisition and rebranded as Coherent Corp.; combined lasers, materials, and networking platform.
BCPE Watson filed SC 13D activist stake; later amendments through 2024.
Mandatory convertible preferred and common equity raise to fund Coherent merger integration.
Early activist 13D filings (BCPE Watson predecessor entities) on legacy II-VI.

industry.structure: Oligopolistic photonics and optical components with high R&D and capital intensity; customer concentration among hyperscalers and telecom OEMs creates bargaining-power asymmetry.
industry.share_shift: Coherent gaining datacom/transceiver share on AI cluster buildout while industrial laser demand remains cyclical; Chinese local suppliers compete on cost in some materials niches.
industry.trend: AI datacenter optical interconnect capex is the growth engine; integration of II-VI and Coherent still absorbing amortization and debt service; segment reporting shifts to datacom vs industrial in FY2026.
